name: Studio
reference: Apple product films and keynote slides: one subject, near-white space, one sentence per scene.
pattern: Near-white grey ground, near-black type, one system blue kept for a link or a selected state. The product supplies all other colour.
personality: Quiet and exact. One subject, a lot of space, one sentence at a time.

motion.character: Slow and certain: long ease-outs, a gentle push of 1-4 %, masks instead of fades for type.
motion.transitions: Cross-dissolve or a cut on a held frame; never a wipe.

texture.note: None. A tight contact shadow under a product is the only depth.

grammar: One subject per scene, centred or on a strong third.
At most two type sizes on screen.
Headlines wrap to two lines at most.
Space is the design: at least 40 % of the frame is empty, on purpose.
needs: A product render or a real screenshot for the subject.

pictures.note: One product photograph in near-white space, clean and true to colour.

footage.note: Slow, bright product b-roll on white.

music.feel: light, optimistic, soft piano and plucks

hits.note: A soft click on a real interaction; a swell into the reveal.

hook.how: The product on frame 0, small in the near-white field, with a gentle push already running. The one sentence lands by 1.5 s.

compose.how: The line first, at the text-safe top (its height from lineH); then the product under it, framed with `room`: the frame under the line, a body line height below it. The product's drawn bounds at their largest over the shot then stay clear of the line by construction: never on the handle or the rim. The anchor `<product id>-object-extent` holds those bounds, to check the gap.

moves.move: A contact shadow under the product: it stands on the ground, it does not float. `product` draws it; a photograph keeps the shadow it was shot with (`photo` adds none).
A cross-dissolve on a held frame between shots, never a wipe or a scale jump.

measurable.how: Each scene change is a blend of two frames over 8-15 frames, with no frame that matches neither shot.

moves.move: A slow push of 1-4 % on every shot, so a hold still breathes.

measurable.how: No stretch longer than maxStill with under 0.15 % of the frame changed.

moves.move: Type rises out of a mask, one line at a time; at least 40 % of the frame stays empty.

measurable.how: The empty share stays at 40 % or more, and no band is empty past its limit.

blocks.for: The product shot, in a small field or full bleed.
A 3D product: it draws the contact shadow.
The one sentence of each scene.

props.label: the unit and what it measures

blocks.for: One number with its meaning, label first.
A soft click on the one real interaction, a swell into the reveal.

props.name: the subject's name
props.line: what it is, or a date or a price

blocks.for: The held finish: the name and what it is, or a date or a price, landing on a beat.

avoid.why: Studio never wipes; it dissolves or cuts on a held frame.
Fast word cuts break the calm, one-sentence pace.

ends.how: The product on its contact shadow, the name in display and one line in headline, centred as one unit. No "Learn more": a film has no link.

mix.note: A light bed under the picture. One click on a real interaction; the swell rises into the reveal.

shots.match: The same product and the same light; change the angle or the action at each cut, never only the scale.

subjectsToAvoid: Fibonacci numbers or the golden spiral
FizzBuzz or a sort of ten numbers
a gadget with no stated job
